name: Citizens Union
lean_basis: Self-described as New York City's oldest nonpartisan good-government group (founded 1897); no independent bias rating found. Used here for its 2026 ballot-proposal positions; its 2026 candidate preferences, if any, were not checked.

name: Common Cause New York
lean_basis: New York chapter of the national nonpartisan watchdog Common Cause; does not endorse candidates. Says its ballot positions are based on government efficiency and checks and balances.

name: The Municipal Art Society of New York (MAS)
lean_basis: Nonprofit civic group focused on planning, historic preservation and public space; no partisan rating. Its positions here are about land use.

name: amNewYork editorial board
lean_basis: Unrated: no AllSides or similar bias rating was found for amNewYork (a free NYC daily owned by Schneps Media), so it is shown as neutral by default, not by evidence.

name: Vital City (editors)
lean_basis: Nonprofit NYC policy publication focused on public safety and government performance; no independent bias rating found. Its institutional view supports all five 2026 proposals; signed contributor op-eds (like Carol Kellermann's on Proposal 5) are not counted as its position.

name: Andrew Rein, president of the Citizens Budget Commission (his own vote, as reported)
lean_basis: An individual's stated vote, reported by THE CITY. The Citizens Budget Commission is a nonpartisan, business-supported fiscal watchdog with no partisan rating; no formal CBC vote recommendation was found.
